title: Union rule for pointwise upper Lipschitz bounds over finitely many closed pieces
statement: Let X, Y be pseudometric spaces, ι a finite type, G : ι → Set X a family of closed sets, B ⊆ ⋃_{k∈ι} G k, g : X → Y, y ∈ X and K ∈ ℝ. Assume that for every k with y ∈ G k and every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 such that d(g(y′), g(y)) ≤ (K + ε)·d(y′, y) for all y′ ∈ G k ∩ B with d(y′, y) < δ. Then for every ε > 0 there is δ > 0 such that d(g(y′), g(y)) ≤ (K + ε)·d(y′, y) for all y′ ∈ B with d(y′, y) < δ. (I.e. if g is K-Lipschitz at y within G k ∩ B for every piece G k containing y, then g is K-Lipschitz at y within B.)
lean_statement: ∀ (X Y : Type) [PseudoMetricSpace X] [PseudoMetricSpace Y] (ι : Type) [Finite ι] (G : ι → Set X) (B : Set X) (g : X → Y) (y : X) (K : ℝ), (∀ k, IsClosed (G k)) → B ⊆ ⋃ k, G k → (∀ k, y ∈ G k → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y' ∈ G k ∩ B, dist y' y < δ → dist (g y') (g y) ≤ (K + ε) * dist y' y) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ y' ∈ B, dist y' y < δ → dist (g y') (g y) ≤ (K + ε) * dist y' y
